# netbox_asn_range (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/ipam/asnrange/):

> An ASN range is a block of AS numbers that belongs to a RIR.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_asn_range" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `rir_id` (Number)
- `start` (Number)

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number)
- `slug` (String)
- `tags` (Set of String)
- `tenant_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
